statements.text: America's warfighters deserve the best tools to win. The #FY26NDAA funds AI, hypersonics, autonomous systems to keep our military the best in the world. https://t.co/GSTrMDUsdc

I think most people are very unaware. Over 75% of the negative stuff on data centers here in the United States is done by communist China on social media platforms, and the reason they are doing that is they don’t want us to have data centers because they want to lead in AI and data centers and they don’t want us to. So much like they interfere in elections and everything else, China is trying to change the narrative here in America.
